purpose: Prioritize research comparisons across retained compound questions; not candidate selection for human use
global_rule: A favorable proxy cannot compensate for a failed required functional domain. Missing, contradictory, and adverse results remain visible.

cards.question: Which exposure limitation remains after starting with the already orally active mouse parent?
cards.existing_reference: 2023 compound 10s; chemically distinct from SLU-PP-332; prior atlas exact-graph panel
cards.newly_qualified: Oral mouse plasma half-life 18-28 minutes; suspension dose-response plateau and one-hour repeated-administration sampling context
cards.next_computational_artifact: Route-resolved intact-parent concentration-time intake table with route/timing discrepancy log; calculate AUC only if an adequate table is obtained
required_endpoints: ERR isoform activity and maximal response
stop_or_redirect: Absolute F inferred from a single concentration or intraperitoneal comparator
Total signal mistaken for intact parent
A structural edit selected before distinguishing dissolution, chemical loss and metabolism
unknowns: Source Figure 1 timing and Figure 3A route conflicts

cards.question: Does better exposure retain repair function in the intended donor and tissue context?
cards.existing_reference: Prior atlas parent/cap matrix, K14Q function-clearance counterexample and separate native-name/CB4211 registry records
cards.newly_qualified: Human-adipose-MSC study supplies metabolic activation with impaired repair and mixed secondary outcomes
cards.next_computational_artifact: Donor-linked evidence table stratified by metabolic state, plus a proxy/function discordance analysis only after raw paired data intake
stop_or_redirect: Longer residence substitutes for repair function
A group-level metabolic result is treated as paired with an individual repair outcome
Selected oxygenation benefit erases failed perfusion or fibrosis endpoints

cards.program: SS-31 duration, oral delivery and cost

cards.newly_qualified: FDA label rechecked; no new oral or cost result
cards.next_computational_artifact: Evidence-linked comparison matrix separating intact recovery, free exposure, mitochondrial function and process economics
required_inputs: intact parent and products measured separately
functional comparator at matched free exposure
actual yield, purification, impurity and stability inputs for costing
required_endpoints: duration of function after exposure falls
stop_or_redirect: Protease resistance treated as correction of renal parent clearance
Conjugate or carrier signal counted as active parent
Proteinogenic residue substitution assumed biologically equivalent
Oral route convenience assumed lower material cost

Whether greater plasma residence improves the intended function
